summary: Fixed root causes across RLM and scale estimators, robust/diagnostic statistics (Rainbow, Harvey-Collier, Goldfeld-Quandt, Breusch-Godfrey, ARCH, compare_j, encompassing, Ljung-Box checks), influence (GLM/MLE leverage, plot_influence, discrete get_influence), descriptivestats describe(), knockoff summary, GAM offset, and corr_nearest outputs; roughly 250+ of the 930 shard tests now pass, with the rest (qsturng, tukeyhsd df, Nyblom-Hansen, Lilliefors p-value, spec_white, corrpsd, anova HC) still failing. No full-suite run was done, so the last full-suite result is not recorded.
